content.value_statement: Teams need reliable ways to inspect and update Google Slides without leaving their AI workflow. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through gws CLI commands for Google Slides presentations.
actual_capabilities: Runs gws slides resource and method commands with documented flags.
Creates blank Google Slides presentations using a requested title.
Gets the latest version of a specified presentation.
Applies validated batchUpdate requests to a presentation.
Works with the pages resource for slide page operations.
Uses gws schema output to inspect required parameters and types.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Can only access presentations allowed by the connected Google account.
Does not include full shared authentication guidance inside this file.
Depends on Google Slides API behavior and account quotas.

use_cases.title: Create Planning Decks
use_cases.description: Create a blank Google Slides presentation and return the identifiers needed for later updates.

use_cases.title: Inspect Existing Presentations
use_cases.description: Fetch the latest presentation state before editing slide content, page structure, or metadata.

use_cases.title: Apply Structured Slide Updates
use_cases.description: Use schema-guided batch updates to make repeatable changes across a presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for starting a new presentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a blank Google Slides presentation named Project Kickoff. Return the title, presentation ID, and next command I can use.

prompt_templates.title: Read Presentation Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task for checking an existing deck.
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the latest details for this Google Slides presentation: PRESENTATION_ID. Summarize the slide count and important page identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Batch Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the schema for slides.presentations.batchUpdate. Then prepare the parameters needed to update titles and speaker notes in PRESENTATION_ID.

prompt_templates.title: Update Deck Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced task for coordinated presentation changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the available pages operations for Google Slides. Plan and apply a validated update that adds a section divider slide to PRESENTATION_ID.

output_examples.input: Create a presentation named Q3 Planning.
output_examples.output: Created a blank presentation named Q3 Planning and returned its presentation ID for future commands.

output_examples.input: Get the latest state of an existing sales deck.
output_examples.output: Fetched the current presentation, summarized the page count, and listed the page identifiers needed for edits.

output_examples.input: Apply a validated batch update to a deck.
output_examples.output: Checked the method schema, submitted the update request, and reported which presentation changes were accepted.

best_practices: Run gws slides --help before using a resource or method.
Inspect gws schema output before building parameters or request bodies.
Confirm presentation IDs, account access, and intended changes before batch updates.
anti_patterns: Do not run updates against a presentation ID that has not been verified.
Do not assume parameter names without checking the schema first.
Do not send large batch updates before validating smaller changes.

faq.question: What does this skill control?
faq.answer: It helps an AI assistant use the gws CLI for Google Slides presentation resources and methods.

faq.question: Does it create full slide content by itself?
faq.answer: It can create blank presentations and guide updates, but content depends on the commands and parameters supplied.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The gws CLI must be installed, configured, and authenticated with a Google account that can access the target presentations.

faq.question: Can it edit any Google Slides file?
faq.answer: No. It can only work with presentations available to the authenticated Google account.

faq.question: How should I prepare update requests?
faq.answer: Use gws schema for the target method, then build parameters and request content from that schema.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
